chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: First seeing Gene Krupa as a kid outside Jeffrey Tavern
summary: Playing Jeffrey Tavern on the South Side, Zutty saw a young face listening at the window; Mezz Mezzrow later introduced Gene Krupa at the Savoy, and Zutty recognized him.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Whatever you want to talk about we're going.
Well, should we talked about Gene Krupa when I first saw him.

I was playing in a place on the South Side of Chicago, and Gene Krupa, he lived near there, see. So the drummer sat in the back where the windows would be open and I could see this little face about every night.

At Jeffrey Tavern. Really on the deep South Side, you know? And it was -- and Genie lived in the same neighborhood. So one night Mezzrow brought Gene Krupa into the old Savoy in Chicago, and I could remember that face. I said, now this kid I really know, I can't remember where I saw him at. And Mezzrow brought him in and introduced him to me and I told him, and I said where do you live, and he told me on the South Side. I said, how about Jeffrey Tavern, because I used to see him over the fence, you know, listening to the band and everything like that. And this is way before he got famous, you know, because he was only a kid there.
I mean, before he got drums, even.
I mean, had he got any drums of his own?
Well, I don't even know, I really don't know if he had -- he must have had drums of his own, because I saw him when he was just a kid.
Mezz would have been older than Gene.
Oh, yes, yes. Because (unintelligible) to hear him and me, you know.
Yeah, yeah. And old Mezzrow introduced me to Gene Krupa.
